title: Coding agents in continuous integration
requirement: Run the workstation's two coding agents from GitHub Actions on pull requests and issues with least privilege, or establish that neither action is needed.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: On a fixed set of pull requests: review findings confirmed by a human, permissions requested, and cost per run.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
